name: mariadb-shell-dev
description: Developer task runner for the MariaDB Shell tree. Not a build dependency: the shell itself is built with CMake.

scripts.rut: cd bld/bin && CACHE=../../unittest/rut-filter && LAST=$([ -s "$CACHE" ] && cat "$CACHE" || echo "*") && { [ -n "$RUT_FILTER" ] || { printf "Test filter [%s]: " "$LAST" >&2; read -r RUT_FILTER || true; }; } && FILTER=${RUT_FILTER:-$LAST} && printf "%s\n" "$FILTER" > "$CACHE" && python3 ../../scripts/run_unit_tests.py --binary ./run_unit_tests --shell-binary ./mariadb-shell -t ../../unittest/test-execution-times.txt --gtest_filter="$FILTER"
